name: Koala VR
summary: By My Buddy Banana-Bread: Koala VR is a fan game of Gorilla Tag where there are Koala's instead of Gorilla's! There are many cosmetics to choose from such as... a Koala Gyatt and Epic Sunglasses! There is a 3D printer room, where you can print many things from inside of the game, such as tree's and Koala's. Yes, you can change your color (Pink if Ur awesome). And I don't know if I should be saying this, but yes, there is stuff behind those vents. That was a lot, I'm gonna eat chocolate now :).
